name: bare-paragraphs
note: Bare paragraphs (corpus/ua-styles, UA stylesheet feature): the UA layer gives p block display and 1em block margins; consecutive p margins collapse to a single 1em gap, matching Chrome's rects.

harvest.html:

Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.

How vexingly quick daft zebras jump.
